visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular Asian man with short hair stands shirtless in front of a large hallway mirror. He flexes his right bicep and looks at his reflection with a serious, focused expression. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting his defined pectoral and abdominal muscles. In the background, a dark wooden door and a glimpse of an indoor living area are visible. (2) A person's hand enters from the left edge of the frame, offering a black handheld body composition analyzer handle. The muscular man accepts it, looking at the device and then at the camera with a puzzled expression. He wears grey drawstring athletic shorts with a white logo and has a small wireless microphone clipped to his waistband. (3) The scene shifts to a top-down view of a sleek, black digital scale placed on a light-colored wooden floor. The camera pans and zooms in on the silver circular dial and the 'InBody' brand name printed in white on the textured surface. The reflection of indoor lights can be seen on the metallic footplates. (4) The man stands on the InBody scale with his bare feet precisely positioned on the four metallic electrodes. He reaches down with his right hand to grasp the handle, pulling it up towards his waist. The camera uses a medium shot to capture his full muscular torso and the interaction with the device hardware. (5) A series of extreme close-up shots show the scale's circular monochrome display. It cycles through digital numbers and Traditional Chinese text, indicating weight (77.9kg), body fat percentage (9.4%), muscle mass (40.5kg), and visceral fat levels. The man's toes are visible at the bottom of the frame during the measurement. (6) The muscular man sits on a low grey sofa in a modern living room setting. He holds the InBody scale upright beside him, using his right hand to point at its physical features. He talks enthusiastically to the camera, with a friendly and engaging facial expression. A shelf with designer toys is visible behind him. (7) A close-up shot focuses on the man's hands holding a black smartphone. The screen displays a mobile app with detailed body composition charts, bar graphs, and a large '93' score. He scrolls through the data, demonstrating the automatic sync feature. The app interface is clean with colorful progress indicators. (8) The man stands in the center of the living room, performing a double bicep flex and then a back pose to showcase his muscle definition and symmetry. The camera uses a full shot to capture his physique. The final scene shows the man doing a one-arm dumbbell row in a dark gym environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-energy electronic pop BGM featuring a driving drum beat and bright synth pads. A male speaker's voice is prominent, characterized by a clear, confident, and friendly tone with a moderate conversational pitch. He asks a question with rising intonation, creating engagement. (2) A distinct 'whoosh' sound effect transition occurs, followed by the sound of a device being handled. The speaker's voice shifts to a lower, questioning pitch with a hint of humor. The BGM continues at a steady 120 BPM, providing a constant rhythmic foundation beneath the dialogue. (3) The narration shifts to an informative style with increased speech density and professional articulation. The speaker highlights product benefits, punctuated by digital 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects coinciding with on-screen text. The vocal intensity remains high, conveying excitement and authoritative knowledge about the fitness equipment. (4) As the man stands on the scale, the BGM's bass frequency swells slightly, and subtle transient thuds are audible. The audio quality is studio-clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio, ensuring every word of the technical explanation is understood despite the overlapping upbeat music bed. (5) The video concludes with an energetic call to action. The speaker's arousal level increases, and in the final segment, the BGM's beat becomes more aggressive. The incidental clanking sound of heavy dumbbells is heard, layered with a final musical stinger to close the clip.
